details: CONFIRMED by repro. plugin_dir resolves an entry with "/" relative to os.path.dirname(profile["_path"]). Moving the derived file
from profiles/candidates/ to the bench folder changed that base for every relative entry the base profile carries. Reachable by
benching any candidate made with `relay candidate --copy` against a --set change of it, and by adopting the result.
failing_case: `relay candidate x --copy delegate` (enabled has "x/plugins/delegate"), then `relay bench x --set models.build=haiku`.
The derived profile's _path is now ~/.relay/bench/<ts>/build-haiku.toml, so plugin_dir(derived, "x/plugins/delegate") looks in
~/.relay/bench/<ts>/x/plugins/delegate, ROOT/x/plugins/delegate and ./x/plugins/delegate and returns None. The derived side runs
without the edited delegate plugin (agent_definitions_dir falls back to plugins/delegate/agents) and no message says so; the
comparison measures two changes at once. `relay improve adopt <that file>` then finds no folder, leaves "x/plugins/delegate" in
the new active.toml, and does not copy the edited plugin in. Before the change the derived file sat in profiles/candidates and
the entry resolved. Should: the derived profile resolves its plugins as its base does.
fix_hint: In derive_profile, rewrite each relative plugin entry that resolves for the base into its absolute folder (plugin_dir(base, e)),
so the written file carries absolute paths; adopt's startswith(profiles/candidates) check then still matches.
pass_cases: 1. Candidate x made with --copy delegate under a temp ROOT; d = derive_profile(load_profile("x"), ["models.build=haiku"]); after run_bench (run_one mocked): plugin_dir(d, <x's delegate entry>) is ROOT/profiles/candidates/x/plugins/delegate and agent_definitions_dir(d) is its agents folder.
2. load_profile(<out_dir>/build-haiku.toml) for that derived profile: each enabled plugin entry resolves (plugin_dir is not None) to the same folder as for x.
3. derive_profile of "active" (plain names core, observe, delegate, front): every entry resolves to ROOT/plugins/<name>, as today.
4. The checkout stays clean: profiles/candidates lists the same files before and after the bench (the Q1 test keeps passing).
findings.summary: a --set profile derived from a candidate with copied plugins loses those plugins: relative entries now resolve against the bench folder
